title: Structure placement crosshair cursor
description:
When Structure Mode is on and you press 1, 2, or 3 to place a node, the mouse pointer now becomes a short custom crosshair with a red center dot (default neon orange arms).

The Structure nodes floating panel also has a Placement crosshair color row — quick swatches plus a custom color picker. Your choice is remembered for next time.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building + PDF Viewer on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync, enable Structure Mode, press 1 — the orange/red crosshair should appear over the map.
changeLog: Keys 1/2/3 in Structure Mode show a short neon-orange crosshair with a red center.
Placement crosshair applies on Map Builder and PDF Viewer hit areas.
Structure panel: change crosshair color via swatches or custom picker (saved preference).
